name: linkedin-content-engine-backend
description: Wrappers npm del backend FastAPI (uvicorn + pytest)

scripts.dev:
if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then printf '%s
' 'ERROR: no existe backend/.venv. Crealo e instala las dependencias con: python3.12 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt -r backend/requirements-dev.txt' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn api.main:app --reload --port 8000
